描述_EN: with a removable clip-on cover the mp3 player takes the shape of a barbie girl and comes with changeable outfits and hairstyles in order to keep up with the latest trends. this barbie girls mp3 player, made in china by mattel, was named as one of the top toys of 2007 by the toy retailers association. not only does this device play music but it also doubles as a fashion accessory.
描述_ZN: 有一个可拆卸的夹子盖，MP3播放器采用了芭比女孩的形状，并配有可改变的服装和发型，以便跟上最新的潮流。 这个芭比女孩的MP3播放器，由Mattel在中国制造，被玩具零售商协会评为2007年的最佳玩具之一。 这个设备不仅可以播放音乐，而且还可以作为一个时尚饰品。
